dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Oh wait! I did see loads of strange, glittering rocks when I went out to play earlier! They were really pretty! Some were dark blue, and others, light blue.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: But... When I came back to grab some tools, Granny Yvette stopped me. Said I was too young to be playing with pickaxes...

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I think it was somewhere hereabouts. Wanna take a look?
